name: story-editor
title_zh: 改剧本时每次落笔都先过一遍审校关
tagline_zh: 改实体、改剧本、改记忆，每处改动都带复核回路。适合写到一半发现人设前后矛盾、时间线对不上的编剧和小说作者。
tagline_en: Edit entities, screenplay, and memory with a built-in review loop. For writers tangled in timeline or character.
desc_en: Edit story entities, screenplay, and memory with review loop.
why_zh: 改动不是直接覆盖，而是先提出修改、再过审校，像有个编辑在旁边盯着，防止越改越乱。
why_en: Changes don't overwrite directly—they go through a review pass first, like an editor watching your back against self-inflicted.
limit_zh: 只处理结构化故事实体、剧本和记忆条目，纯散文或自由叙事文本不适用；且需要已有明确实体定义，从零起稿帮不上忙。
limit_en: Only structured story entities, screenplay, and memory items. Free-form prose unsupported; needs pre-defined entities, not for blank-page drafting.
title_en: Story edits pass a review gate before they land
